title: Quorum Project Config
description: Configuration file for a Quorum project. Upload via POST /config/upload or name it <group_id>.quorum.json.

owner.description: GitHub username of the project owner. The owner can transfer ownership and update member roles.

group_id.description: Canonical identifier for this project. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Used as S3 key, DynamoDB primary key, JWT project claim, and Graphiti namespace.

project.description: Human-readable display name shown in the dashboard project picker. Optional — falls back to group_id if not provided.

members.description: Team roster with role and identity signals.

role.description: One of: principal_architect, senior_engineer, engineer, junior

git_email.description: Git committer email — fallback identity signal.

roles.description: Role definitions — sets the base_confidence floor for each role.

base_confidence.description: Confidence floor (0–1). Author-provided confidence below this value is raised to the floor.

domains.description: Per-domain governance overrides (e.g. auth, payments, infra).

conflict_threshold.description: Semantic similarity threshold to trigger conflict detection in this domain. Overrides the global thresholds.conflict_threshold.

required_reviewer_teams.description: Teams whose members are permitted to review knowledge in this domain. Empty array = any team member may review.

thresholds.description: Global conflict and authority thresholds. Domain-level overrides take precedence.

conflict_threshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold to trigger conflict detection.

authority_threshold.description: Minimum authority delta for auto-supersede without conflict.

notifications.description: Webhook notification config — Quorum POSTs here when a conflict enters the human review queue.

webhook_url.description: HTTP(S) URL to POST when a conflict.pending_review event fires.

dashboard_url.description: QUORUM_DASHBOARD_URL override — used to build the dashboard deep-link in the webhook payload.

guest_access.description: Allow any GitHub-authenticated user to read this project's knowledge as a guest. Guests are read-only; all writes are forced to DRAFT.
